items.text: President Biden is right to utilize the Defense Protection Act—as I’ve urged—to help ease the infant formula shortage. Parents need solutions. We must work urgently to provide vital nutrition to babies. More imports too.

Rumbling empty stomachs stymie student success—which is why I so strongly supported the Keep Kids Fed Act, passed last Thursday, extending & expanding nutrition programs. CT will receive hundreds of millions of dollars to deliver more than 70 million meals, like here at Weaver. https://t.co/FGsBke5vgu

The College Athletes Bill of Rights will compel colleges to put athletes’ wellness above profits. While the NCAA’s draconian rules have built a broken, unfair system on the backs of these athletes’ blood, sweat&tears, this measure invests in their educational&economic futures.

I agree, @SenWhitehouse. What we are seeing is a concerted effort to shatter our free & fair electoral process while threatening the patriotic poll workers making sure Americans can exercise their right to vote.

For years I’ve called for polluters to pay the price for contaminating our communities with these dangerous forever chemicals. The EPA is right to start this PFAS rulemaking—increasing accountability & taking steps to improve environmental health & safety. https://t.co/OFcLPSQImO

Congrats to Suni Unger, founder of Greenwich Wine + Food on a spectacular 10th anniversary celebration, honoring two iconic CT culinary leaders known worldwide, Jacques Pépin & Michel Nischan, & the great skill training & nutrition activism they support.

This new Recovery & Wellness Center at the Cornell Scott Hill Health Center in New Haven will save lives in the midst of a substance use disorder epidemic. I’m proud to announce a $650,000 federal grant supporting it—& look forward to the ribbon cutting. https://t.co/k69pwjJnU8

More federal money for the SNAP program & child nutrition is an investment in the future of our families & young people. We will not stand by as people in CT face hunger. I will continue to fight at the federal level for food security & increased funds. https://t.co/I5n099qmpD

More than just a rhetorical exercise, today’s FAA Safety Call To Action must in fact produce action to reform our underfunded & overwhelmed aviation system. Safety leadership has been lacking in airlines, the FAA &, yes, Congress. https://t.co/zdEACRfKSt
Fixing this discriminatory practice is long overdue. It’s time to ensure our nation’s nutrition aid is available to all who need it.

Tick-borne diseases, like ticks, are exploding in number. Babesiosis cases rose 338%, Lyme doubled in recent years. I helped get $200,000 to CT’s Agricultural Station, $26 million to CDC, $7 million to DOD, all for vital research, diagnosis, & treatment. https://t.co/51D3z9Z0jQ

No excuse for DOD disregarding K2 veterans’ care. They deserve vital information about exposure to toxins from DOD. I stand with the @SFF_K2, @CTVeteransLegal, & @YaleVetsClinic as they fight for necessary treatment, diagnoses, & justice. https://t.co/B4wfZtgn5H

5 people trying to get some sleep were senselessly gunned down. Yet again we are faced with the horrific, deadly tragedy of gun violence. We are the only country in the world that lives like this—because the NRA & their Congressional puppets block action. Enough is enough.

Wonderful to be at KNOX’s community gardens. Eating well is key to longevity & a good quality of life. Fresh produce at CT farmers markets is available to eligible seniors through the farmers market nutrition program. We must support this effort & our local farmers. https://t.co/JwFoQPETwE
I hope the President’s anticipated supplemental will be robust in providing food, medical treatment and shelter to all who need it.

RSV is the leading cause of infant hospitalization & yet we face a shortage of the antibody treatment that can help prevent it. Unacceptable. I urge pharmaceutical manufacturers to make this treatment more accessible & affordable. https://t.co/F5kDdYRDP2

Pharma manufacturers responsible for lifesaving RSV treatment shortages can’t let it continue, or happen again. We’re demanding answers—why did it happen, what are you doing about it, & more. Glad the Administration is doing so too. https://t.co/eiZmMem9Od

We fought to pass the PACT Act for years & I couldn’t be happier that the Biden Administration has expanded eligibility to ensure every veteran suffering from the horrific & insidious diseases caused by burn pits & toxic chemicals has access to treatment.

The bipartisan funding compromise announced today marks a solid investment in housing, nutrition, veterans, & other vital programs. No cuts. No poison pill riders. Now we need to get them across the finish line with continued bipartisan work & votes. https://t.co/EO1Jq0YUno

As March Madness begins, I’m demanding that sports betting companies stop targeting problem gamblers with promotions & pitches, spreading addiction & tragedy. Instead, they should offer treatment, & tools to self-exclude.

My GRIT Act would provide federal resources for treatment & research to address gambling addiction—half of revenue from the 0.25% excise tax on betting. A small fraction of the federal budget, it could make a big difference.

I’m writing to the FTC demanding it investigate whether infant weighted sleep products were unfairly or deceptively advertised as safe. In the meantime, Amazon must expeditiously implement its new policy to remove these products from its site & warn consumers who purchased them. https://t.co/JBvuvnjKWQ

Weighted infant sleep sacks restrict babies’ movements&put pressure on their chests—potentially impacting their breathing. I applaud Amazon, Walmart&Target for pulling these products, but the FTC must investigate the manufacturers’ misleading marketing&overblown safety promises. https://t.co/djs3GB8mhJ

Wonderful to be at Waterbury’s Pride Flag raising. People should not be discriminated against because of who they are or who they love. All Americans deserve equal treatment under the law & that’s why I will keep fighting for the Equality Act. https://t.co/4VtdxuyYe1

The full Court should've sided with Justice Jackson in holding that the federal Emergency Medical Treatment&Labor Act supersedes Idaho’s state ban,&guarantees reproductive health care when necessary in an emergency, providing certainty&consistency to women in Idaho&everywhere. 3/
